note: Styled Google Map renders a geofield as a Google Map via a field formatter (id styled_google_map_default, field type geofield) and a Views style (id styled_google_map). Rendering the actual map needs a Google Maps API key (external), so all medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL Drupal config that is verifiable without any Google service: the global config object styled_google_map.settings (keys styled_google_map_google_auth_method 1=API Key/2=Work, styled_google_map_google_apikey, styled_google_map_google_client_id) and the entity_view_display formatter assignment. Introspection reads back a stored key / a formatter assignment; execution builds a formatter assignment and sets the API key, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site using the styled_google_map module, where do I set the Google Maps API key, and what config object and admin route hold it? Also name the two authentication methods it supports.
evals.expected_output: Set it on the settings form at /admin/config/services/styled_google_map (route styled_google_map.settings), stored in config object styled_google_map.settings under styled_google_map_google_apikey. The auth method key styled_google_map_google_auth_method is 1 = API Key or 2 = Google Maps API for Work (which uses styled_google_map_google_client_id).

evals.prompt: I have a geofield on my Article content type and I want to display it as a Styled Google Map. What is the field formatter's machine id and which field type does it apply to?
evals.expected_output: Use the styled_google_map_default field formatter on Manage display; it applies only to fields of type geofield. For many markers from a View instead, use the Views style whose id is styled_google_map.

evals.prompt: Which hook does styled_google_map provide to let me change the markers and map settings of a Views-based map in PHP before it renders, and what data does it receive?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_styled_google_map_views_style_alter(array &$variables). It receives $variables['map_settings'] (mutable — settings plus a 'locations' array of every marker) and $variables['context'] ('view' and 'options', read-only, for conditions).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has a Google Maps API key configured for the styled_google_map module. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the exact API key value and which authentication method (API Key or Maps for Work) is selected.
evals.expected_output: In config object styled_google_map.settings, styled_google_map_google_apikey is 'AIzaSyEVAL-known-key-001' and styled_google_map_google_auth_method is 1 (API Key).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site shows a location field as a Styled Google Map on its default display. Inspect the live view display and give the machine name of that geofield.
evals.expected_output: It is field_sgm_known: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_sgm_known component uses formatter type styled_google_map_default (width 777px).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a geofield named field_sgm_map that is currently not displayed. Using the styled_google_map module, configure the default view display for Article so this field renders as a Styled Google Map. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_sgm_map component formatter type to styled_google_map_default (e.g. $display->setComponent('field_sgm_map', ['type' => 'styled_google_map_default', ...])->save(), or pick 'Styled Google Map' on Manage display).

evals.prompt: Configure the styled_google_map module to use the Google Maps API Key authentication method with the API key 'AIzaSyEVAL-set-me-999'. Apply the change to the live site's configuration.
evals.expected_output: In config object styled_google_map.settings set styled_google_map_google_apikey to 'AIzaSyEVAL-set-me-999' and styled_google_map_google_auth_method to 1 (API Key), e.g. drush config:set styled_google_map.settings styled_google_map_google_apikey 'AIzaSyEVAL-set-me-999'.
